facts.F1: ADO Story #6650, split out of Story #6625. Feedback from a community user: he could not find Delete on the report list; it sits in the last column and scrolls out of view. The cause is in the shared DataGridBase, used by the report list, the Overview tables (DataOverviewTable) and other tables (FeatureGrid, FeatureListDataGrid, WorkItemsDialog, ArchivedFeatureGrid, ConnectionsSettings, ThirdPartyPackagesSection, RefinementGrid). The maintainer sees the same problem on the Overview. Maintainer decision (2026-11-15): both. 1) Columns fit the available width better: they shrink, and long names truncate with a tooltip. 2) When columns still do not fit, a visible cue (shadow or fade on the edge) shows there is more to scroll to.

facts.F88: Fit carrier: DataGridColumn gains an optional fit choice, ColumnFit = { kind: text, minWidth? } | { kind: content } | { kind: actions }. When a column declares none, it is derived: a column with flex is text, any other column is content. So S1 changes every DataGridBase table at once without editing them, and S3 and S4 only mark columns where the derivation is wrong. The single owner of the fit rule is a new pure module columnFit.ts (fitColumn(column, storedWidth) returns the MUI column props: flex, width, minWidth, resizable, cell and header class). DataGridBase calls it in its column memo and keeps no width rule of its own. Text: flex = column.flex or 1, minWidth = fit.minWidth or DEFAULT_TEXT_MIN_WIDTH 120 px, cell does not wrap and truncates. Content: fixed width, minWidth = that width, never flex, never ellipsised. Actions: content plus pinned. The fit itself is the community grid flex pass (leftover width shared among flex columns, never below minWidth); when the minima do not fit, the grid scroller scrolls.
facts.F89: Truncation: text cells render through a new TruncatedCell component in the DataGrid folder: a nowrap box with overflow hidden and text-overflow ellipsis, inside an MUI Tooltip that carries the full text. The full text is the column value (valueGetter or field value as a string); a renderCell output keeps its own element inside the box and the tooltip text comes from the value. The tooltip opens on hover and while the cell or an element inside it has keyboard focus (focusin and focusout on the box, plus the grid focused-cell state for the cell itself), and only when the text is cut (scrollWidth greater than clientWidth at open). The full text stays in the DOM, so assistive technology reads it whole. Content and actions cells keep the current centred cell layout and are never cut. Row height stays auto.

facts.F91: Edge cue: a new pure function overflowEdges(scrollLeft, viewportWidth, contentWidth) in horizontalOverflow.ts returns a closed value none | left | right | both, with a one-pixel tolerance. A hook useHorizontalOverflow(apiRef) in the same module reads the grid root dimensions (apiRef getRootDimensions: content size and viewport inner size) and the scroll position, and recomputes on the grid events scrollPositionChange, resize, columnWidthChange and columnVisibilityModelChange. DataGridBase renders two decorative overlays (aria-hidden, pointer-events none) from that value: the left one at the left edge of the scroller, the right one at the left edge of the pinned actions column (or the right edge when there is none). The wrapper carries data-overflow with the same value, and a visually hidden text referenced from the grid with aria-describedby says that the table scrolls sideways and columns are hidden on the named side, so the cue is not shadow alone. Keyboard: the grid already scrolls a focused cell into view; on cellFocusIn DataGridBase additionally scrolls left by the overlap when the focused cell ends under the pinned actions column, because the community grid does not know a custom pinned column.
